events.title: Detention
events.speaker: Mr. B
events.text: The vice principal's office smells like toner and patience running out. Mr. B doesn't look up from your file. "Three skips. This isn't personal. It's policy." He slides a form across the desk.

choices.label: Apologize and sign it
choices.result: "Good." He puts your file in a drawer. A thick drawer.

choices.label: "Is this really the best use of your time?"
choices.result: He finally looks up. "You'll find I have a great deal of time." It does not sound like a joke.

choices.label: Stare out the window the whole hour
choices.result: Outside, the light by the woods flickers in a way light shouldn't. Mr. B pulls the blind down without comment.

events.title: Detention again
events.speaker: Mr. B
events.text: "Back so soon." Mr. B has a second file now, thinner, labeled with a date from before you moved here. He notices you noticing.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.result: He closes it. "Students who keep their heads down do very well in this town."

choices.label: Ask about the file
choices.result: "Administrative." He files it away. You catch one word on the tab: INCONVENIENT.
